correctness.rationale: For each of n=6,7,8, a finite independent verifier checks exactly F_n vertex-sequence certificates, admissible graph edges, geodesicity via endpoint Hamming equality, and complete edge coverage. The graph distance equals Hamming distance by first clearing and then setting differing bits, so each geodesic can cover at most one first-coordinate edge; hence the cover optimum is exactly F_n. Two endpoint coordinate edge classes give a 2F_n feasible general-position set; the cover implies the matching upper bound for any set. All graph and certificate paths are included and were checked with a second independent BFS distance reconstruction. No inference is made about dimension nine or above.

value.rationale: Klavžar–Tan Conjecture 4.5 is a natural open invariant in Fibonacci cubes. The 2023 primary paper proves through dimension five only; exact dimensions six, seven and eight are the immediate subsequent instances, not an arbitrary slice. The finding also establishes matching exact shortest-path covering numbers with compact reproducible combinatorial witnesses (8,13,21 paths), and a principled duality argument explains the equality. It makes bounded but substantive progress without claiming the full conjecture or significant general downstream consequences.
